description: The pass is set to not recorded over rows that all stand at Supports or Not Applicable. The status sentence is the decision's — machine-audited, and not conformant until the pass is on record. The pass is read before the rows: a rule that read the rows alone would put the stronger word on a report with no transcript behind it, which is the lie 0061 was written against.

says: until the assistive-technology pass is on record
